lessons.titleZh: 被情緒或氣氛捲入其中

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Buyers can be swept up in the launch excitement.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page101, table1, row3; unreported locators remain null.

brief.meaningEn: Become strongly absorbed in an emotion or shared excitement, which may influence attention or choices.
brief.meaningZh: 深深投入某種情緒或共同興奮，可能影響注意或選擇。
brief.grammar: be/get/become swept up in + excitement/emotion; passive swept; identify the feeling and its observable effect.
brief.register: Figurative sweeping image. Enjoying a shared moment is not inherently irresponsible, and influence need not remove choice.
brief.boundaryZh: 情緒感染不自動代表完全失去判斷、受騙或有錯；需看實際反應。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可承認氣氛影響，也保留自己對承諾的責任。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述被感染的感受及具體後果，不誇大成無法自主。

listening.en: At the open studio, I was swept up in the excitement and signed up for the group project before checking its dates; later I realised one session clashed with a commitment I already had.
listening.zh: 開放工作室中，我被興奮氣氛感染，未查日期便報小組項目；後來發現一節與已有承諾撞期。

options.en: The speaker enrolled before checking the schedule and later found a clash.
options.zh: 說話者未查時間表便報名，後來發現撞期。

options.en: The speaker checked all dates before agreeing to join.
options.zh: 說話者答應前已查所有日期。

options.en: The group changed the dates after the speaker had completed the project.
options.zh: 說話者完成項目後，小組才改日期。

options.en: The speaker declined the project because the atmosphere was quiet.
options.zh: 說話者因氣氛安靜而拒絕項目。

listening.explanationZh: 興奮與先報後查連在一起，撞期是已給後果，不推成別人強迫。

reply.promptEn: Why did you miss the date clash when you enrolled?
reply.promptZh: 報名時你為甚麼漏看撞期？

options.en: I agreed in the excitement before looking properly at the schedule.
options.zh: 我興奮地先答應，未仔細看時間表。

options.en: I was swept up in the excitement and did not check the dates first.
options.zh: 我被興奮感染，沒有先查日期。

options.en: The shared enthusiasm drew my attention away from the practical timing.
options.zh: 共同熱情令我沒留意實際時間。

options.en: I joined impulsively and noticed my earlier commitment only afterwards.
options.zh: 我一時衝動加入，之後才留意原有承諾。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都有先同意後核的依據，不把責任全推給氣氛。

scene.promptZh: 故事人物原本只想旁聽，大家一起唱熟悉歌曲時，她被歡樂感染，也開始跟唱，沒有另作承諾。哪句準確？

options.en: She was swept up in the joy of the song and joined in.
options.zh: 她被歌曲歡樂感染，也加入唱。

options.en: She joined the group’s rehearsals regularly after the song.
options.zh: 那首歌後，她定期參加小組排練。

options.en: She remained detached and did not take part in the singing.
options.zh: 她一直置身事外，沒有加入唱。

scene.explanationZh: 只給當下歡樂及跟唱，未說後來定期排練，也不是一直置身事外。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 swept up in the excitement 推出？

options.en: Excitement strongly involves the person.
options.zh: 興奮令當事人深深投入。

options.en: The person has no responsibility for any later commitment.
options.zh: 當事人對之後任何承諾都沒有責任。

options.en: The context can show whether the influence was helpful or unhelpful.
options.zh: 情境可顯示影響有幫助或無幫助。

contrast.explanationZh: 受感染不等於所有選擇均無責任。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因你被氣氛感染，就把報名寫成別人已替你核日期；其實你自己先答應。哪句最好？

options.en: I was swept up in the excitement, but I still need to acknowledge that I agreed before checking my dates.
options.zh: 我被興奮感染，但仍需承認自己未查日期便答應。

options.en: The group checked my dates before I enrolled.
options.zh: 我報名前，小組已核我的日期。

options.en: I waited until my existing commitment had ended before enrolling.
options.zh: 我等原有承諾結束後才報名。

dialogue.explanationZh: 我先答應、後查出與已有承諾撞期，不能改成小組早已查，或原承諾已結束才加入。

speaking.en: I was swept up in the excitement, so I want to check what I actually agreed to before making another promise.
speaking.zh: 我被興奮感染，所以再作承諾前，想核自己實際答應了甚麼。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再兼顧情緒影響與實際承諾。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：家人找到一張失散多年的合照，你們看照片時非常興奮，你忘了感謝替你比日期、找到線索的朋友。你現在想發訊息補上具體謝意，不把找照片說成自己的功勞。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: We were swept up in the excitement of seeing the old photograph, and I forgot to thank you properly. Your careful comparison of the dates helped us find it.
examples.zh: 我們看到舊照片時被興奮感染，我忘了好好謝你；是你仔細比較日期，幫我們找到它。

examples.en: I was swept up in the happy memories when the photograph appeared, but I want to acknowledge the work you did. Thank you for following the clues and checking the dates.
examples.zh: 照片出現時，我投入快樂回憶，但想肯定你做的工作；謝謝你追線索及核日期。

writing.selfCheckZh: 承認興奮中漏謝，再指出朋友找線索核日期的貢獻，不把情緒當否認別人功勞的理由。

takeaways.en: The visitors were swept up in the celebration and began sharing stories of their own.
takeaways.zh: 訪客被慶祝氣氛感染，開始分享自己的故事。

takeaways.en: She was swept up in the argument before noticing that they were discussing different versions of the plan.
takeaways.zh: 她捲入爭論後，才留意大家談的是計劃不同版本。

review.author: AI author source_inventory

english.evidence: Absorption in emotion can be positive, distracting or conflictual. Final is a specific overdue thank-you acknowledging another person’s research, unlike an enrolment decision or chorus participation.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese personally compared against each English subject, polarity, qualification and referent; no human approval claimed.

review.note: Individual author draft; separate independent editorial, media, QA and publication checks pending.

lessons.titleZh: 放在口袋裏炫示身份的獎杯

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A luxury phone can feel like a trophy in your pocket.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page101, table1, row4; unreported locators remain null.

brief.meaningEn: A possession experienced or displayed as proof of status rather than valued only for practical use.
brief.meaningZh: 把擁有物當身份或地位的證明，不只看實際用途。
brief.grammar: feel like/treat something as a trophy in one’s pocket; specify the possession and the status it signals.
brief.register: Creative possession-as-trophy metaphor in the source; not a literal competition award.
brief.boundaryZh: 需有身份展示線索；昂貴本身不證物主虛榮，也不表示物品沒有實用價值。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可檢視某次展示行動，不以一件物品判整個人品格。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述地位象徵與實際用途的張力。

listening.en: In the story, the new phone felt like a trophy in his pocket: he kept showing the logo at school, although he had not tried the camera he said he needed for the project.
listening.zh: 故事中，新手機像他口袋的獎杯；他在校不斷亮標誌，卻還沒試自己說項目需要的相機。

options.en: He displayed the label as a sign of status before exploring the stated practical feature.
options.zh: 他先展示標誌作身份訊號，未探索所說實用功能。

options.en: He won the phone as a prize in a camera competition.
options.zh: 他在相機比賽贏手機獎品。

options.en: He had already tested the camera against the project’s needs.
options.zh: 他已按項目需要測相機。

options.en: The story proves the phone has no working camera.
options.zh: 故事證明手機沒有可用相機。

listening.explanationZh: 展示標誌及未試用途支持象徵地位，不知功能壞，也不是實際獎品。

reply.promptEn: Why does the narrator compare the phone to a trophy?
reply.promptZh: 敘述者為甚麼把手機比作獎杯？

options.en: The character keeps showing its logo rather than testing the camera.
options.zh: 角色不停亮標誌，不去試相機。

options.en: It feels like a trophy in his pocket because he uses it to display status.
options.zh: 它像口袋獎杯，因他用來顯示身份。

options.en: The possession seems to matter as something others will notice.
options.zh: 他似乎重視擁有物會被別人留意。

options.en: His behaviour emphasises recognition more than the use he claimed to need.
options.zh: 他的行為較重被認同，而非自己所說需要的用途。

reply.explanationZh: 四句以行動支持身份象徵，不把價格單獨當證據。

scene.promptZh: 人物用一部舊相機多年，細查電池及鏡頭才借給朋友，沒有展示品牌。哪句最不適合只據這些行動推出？

options.en: The camera is functioning as a trophy in her pocket to impress others.
options.zh: 相機正像她口袋獎杯，用來令別人羨慕。

options.en: She pays attention to the camera’s practical condition.
options.zh: 她留意相機實際狀況。

options.en: The account does not yet show status-seeking behaviour.
options.zh: 敘述尚未顯示追求身份展示的行為。

scene.explanationZh: 已給的是維護及借出行動，未給炫耀身份；不能單由擁有相機套比喻。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 a trophy in your pocket 的比喻推出？

options.en: A possession can be used as a status symbol.
options.zh: 擁有物可用作身份象徵。

options.en: The object must have been won in a formal competition.
options.zh: 該物必定在正式比賽贏得。

options.en: The context should show why recognition matters to the owner.
options.zh: 情境應顯示物主為何重視被認同。

contrast.explanationZh: 比喻獎杯不必真的得獎。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因角色亮手機標誌，就寫相機必壞；故事只說未試。哪句最好？

options.en: It may be a trophy in his pocket, but we should keep the camera’s actual performance untested rather than call it broken.
options.zh: 它可能像口袋獎杯，但應保留相機表現未測，不說已壞。

options.en: The camera failed a test during the project.
options.zh: 相機在項目期間測試失敗。

options.en: The narrator uses trophy only for a literal prize won in a competition.
options.zh: 敘述者只用獎杯指真正比賽獎品。

dialogue.explanationZh: 此處是地位比喻，實際相機仍未測；不是已測失敗，也不是確有比賽得獎。

speaking.en: The device became a trophy in my pocket when I cared more about showing it than using it for the work.
speaking.zh: 我較在意展示而非用它工作時，裝置便成為我口袋的獎杯。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再用行動解釋身份象徵。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你加入書友社，歡迎會有人提議大家亮會員卡介紹自己。你不想把卡當身份獎杯，想先自願幫展覽讀一段說明，仍會用會員卡登記。你要寫便條提出自己的參與方式，不批評別人會籍。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: I need the card to sign in, but I do not want it to become a trophy in my pocket. Could I contribute by reading a passage of the exhibition notes rather than introducing myself through the card?
examples.zh: 我需用卡登記，但不想讓它變成口袋獎杯；可否透過讀一段展覽說明作貢獻，而不靠亮卡介紹自己？

examples.en: Instead of treating the card as a trophy in my pocket, I would like to help check the exhibition notes. I can use it for registration without making it the centre of my introduction.
examples.zh: 與其把卡當口袋獎杯，我想幫核展覽說明；我可用它登記，不把它當自介中心。

glossary.en: a passage of the exhibition notes

writing.selfCheckZh: 交代會員卡仍供登記，另提出以閱讀展覽說明參與的方式；不靠展示身份取代貢獻，也不貶低別人會籍。

takeaways.en: He carried the exclusive card like a trophy in his pocket, mentioning it before he had attended any meetings.
takeaways.zh: 他像口袋獎杯般帶着專屬會員卡，尚未參加聚會已不斷提它。

takeaways.en: The badge felt like a trophy in her pocket until she began to value the work behind it more than the label.
takeaways.zh: 直到她較重視背後工作而非標籤前，徽章感覺像她口袋獎杯。

review.author: AI author source_inventory

english.evidence: Final changes object and practical goal to declining a status-card introduction while requesting a specific voluntary contribution and preserving registration use; no phone/logo/filming retelling.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese personally compared against each English subject, polarity, qualification and referent; no human approval claimed.

review.note: Individual author draft; separate independent editorial, media, QA and publication checks pending.

sources.sentence: She worried about missing out on the sale.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page101, table1, row5; unreported locators remain null.

sources.sentence: Children may miss out on family stories.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page136, table1, row5; unreported locators remain null.

sources.sentence: Children may miss out on family stories.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page170, table1, row4; unreported locators remain null.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Children may miss out on family stories.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page229, table1, row3; unreported locators remain null.

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Children may miss out on family stories.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page269, table1, row4; unreported locators remain null.

brief.meaningEn: Fail to receive, experience or take part in an opportunity.
brief.meaningZh: 未能獲得、體驗或參與某個機會。
brief.grammar: miss out; miss out on + noun/-ing; missed/missing; on introduces the opportunity, not an object directly after out.
brief.register: Common phrasal verb. It can express concern about a possible loss, not proof that the experience is essential or the person regrets a choice.
brief.boundaryZh: 需說明錯過甚麼；未參與一項不代表被排斥所有活動、必受損或沒有其他學習。
brief.misconceptionZh: 害怕錯過與機會已失去不同，也不表示必須接受所有邀請。
brief.outcomeZh: 能準確說明機會、時序及替代安排。

listening.en: I missed out on the live questions because I could not attend the workshop that evening, but the organiser sent the notes and offered to collect a written question afterwards.
listening.zh: 那晚不能出席工作坊，我錯過即場提問，但主辦者寄來筆記，並提出之後可收一條書面問題。
listening.promptZh: 錯過的是甚麼，仍有甚麼？

options.en: The live question period was missed, while notes and a written follow-up remained available.
options.zh: 錯過即場提問，仍可看筆記及書面跟進。

options.en: The speaker attended and asked a live question that evening.
options.zh: 說話者當晚到場，問了即場問題。

options.en: The organiser refused to share any notes or accept a later question.
options.zh: 主辦者拒絕分享筆記或收之後問題。

options.en: The written question had already been answered before the workshop began.
options.zh: 工作坊開始前，書面問題已答好。

listening.explanationZh: 錯過即場環節不等於所有資源都沒了；written follow-up仍是後續可用選項。

reply.promptEn: What did you lose by not attending that evening?
reply.promptZh: 那晚沒出席，你錯過甚麼？

options.en: I could not take part in the questions as the workshop happened.
options.zh: 工作坊進行時，我不能參與提問。

options.en: I missed out on the live questions, although I could follow up in writing.
options.zh: 我錯過即場提問，但可書面跟進。

options.en: The real-time exchange was unavailable to me that evening.
options.zh: 那晚我未能參與即時交流。

options.en: I lost the chance to ask during the session rather than all access to the material.
options.zh: 我失去環節中發問的機會，而非完全不能接觸資料。

reply.explanationZh: 四句限定即場交流，保留筆記及書面問題。

scene.promptZh: 你選擇陪家人遠足，不能參與同日的音樂會；你很滿意遠足，並非後悔，但確實沒聽現場演出。哪句準確？

options.en: I missed out on the concert, but I was glad I chose the family walk.
options.zh: 我錯過音樂會，但很高興選了家庭遠足。

options.en: I regretted choosing the walk instead of attending the concert.
options.zh: 我後悔選遠足，沒去音樂會。

options.en: I chose the concert and postponed the family walk.
options.zh: 我選音樂會，延後家庭遠足。

scene.explanationZh: 錯過體驗與對選擇後悔不同；題目已給滿意遠足的感受。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 worried about missing out 推出？

options.en: Someone fears losing a chance to experience something.
options.zh: 有人怕失去體驗某事的機會。

options.en: The feared loss has already happened.
options.zh: 所怕的損失已經發生。

options.en: The actual opportunity and timing still need context.
options.zh: 實際機會及時序仍需情境。

contrast.explanationZh: 擔心可能錯過，不等於已經錯過。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說沒去即場提問就不能學到工作坊內容，但你已收到筆記及可補書面問題。哪句最好？

options.en: I missed out on the live exchange, not every way of learning from the workshop; I can read the notes and follow up.
options.zh: 我錯過即時交流，不是所有學習方法；我可讀筆記及跟進。

options.en: We should discard the notes because they were sent after the session.
options.zh: 筆記在環節後寄出，所以應丟掉。

options.en: The later notes mean I can describe myself as having attended the live questions.
options.zh: 之後的筆記表示，我可說自己出席了即場提問。

dialogue.explanationZh: 保留體驗差異及仍可用資源，不以替代品改寫出席事實。

speaking.en: I may miss out on the discussion, so I will ask what notes or follow-up options are available.
speaking.zh: 我可能錯過討論，所以會問有甚麼筆記或跟進選項。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再交代可能錯過及可查替代。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：朋友邀你買有折扣的畫具，你已有可用工具，暫不打算買。你想禮貌說可能錯過折扣也接受，仍願一起畫，不把拒買說成拒絕朋友。用一至兩句英文回覆。

examples.en: I may miss out on the discount, but the tools I have still work for our drawing session. I would be happy to join you without buying another set.
examples.zh: 我可能錯過折扣，但已有工具仍適合我們畫畫；我樂意不再買一套，也一起參與。

examples.en: I do not mind missing out on this offer because I can use my current materials. Thank you for thinking of me; I still want to draw together.
examples.zh: 我不介意錯過這優惠，因我可用現有材料；謝謝你想到我，我仍想一起畫。

writing.selfCheckZh: 承認可能錯過折扣，禮貌保留一起畫的意願，不編優惠無效，也不把拒買當拒朋友。

takeaways.en: The children missed out on the family stories until their aunt began recording them.
takeaways.zh: 阿姨開始錄家族故事前，孩子一直沒機會聽到。

takeaways.en: I was worried about missing out, so I checked the actual dates before agreeing to the invitation.
takeaways.zh: 我擔心錯過，所以答應邀請前先核實際日期。

lessons.titleZh: 支付高於通常價格的額外費用

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Customers are paying a premium for the new label.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page101, table1, row8; unreported locators remain null.

brief.meaningEn: Pay an amount above the ordinary or base price, often for a feature, service or name.
brief.meaningZh: 支付比通常或基本價格高的金額，常為功能、服務或品牌。
brief.grammar: pay a premium for + feature/service; paid/paying; identify the base comparison and what the extra payment covers.
brief.register: Standard commercial phrase, not automatically a judgement of good or bad value. It differs from describing something as premium quality.
brief.boundaryZh: 多付錢不證品質必好或交易不公，需分清實際加項及是否有價值。
brief.misconceptionZh: 願付額外費用與已付款不同，也不能由premium一字推具體數字。
brief.outcomeZh: 能清楚解釋額外費用對應甚麼，保留價值判斷的範圍。

listening.en: In the case study, the journal paid a premium for delivery before the festival rather than the standard service a week later; the higher price covered speed, not a different paper quality.
listening.zh: 案例中，刊物付額外費用讓印本在節慶前送到，而非一周後的標準服務；較高價格是為速度，不是不同紙質。
listening.promptZh: 額外費用買到哪項差異？

options.en: Earlier delivery rather than a change in paper quality.
options.zh: 較早送達，而非紙質改變。

options.en: A heavier paper while the delivery date stayed the same.
options.zh: 較厚紙張，送達日則相同。

options.en: The ordinary service at exactly the base price.
options.zh: 按基本價使用一般服務。

options.en: A refund because the journal chose the slower option.
options.zh: 刊物選較慢方案，所以獲退款。

listening.explanationZh: 比較是早送及一周後標準服務，已明說紙質沒變。

reply.promptEn: Why did the journal pay more than the standard delivery price?
reply.promptZh: 刊物為甚麼付比標準運送更高的價格？

options.en: It wanted the copies before the festival rather than a week later.
options.zh: 它想節慶前收到印本，而非一周後。

options.en: It paid a premium for earlier delivery, not for different paper.
options.zh: 它為較早送達付額外費用，不是為不同紙張。

options.en: The extra payment bought a faster service.
options.zh: 額外付款換取較快服務。

options.en: The timing mattered enough in the story for the journal to choose the higher-priced option.
options.zh: 故事中時點對刊物夠重要，令它選較貴方案。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都解釋實際加項，不以價高推紙好。

scene.promptZh: 同款袋有一般印字及手寫名字兩種，故事人物付較高費用選手寫，但還未比較耐用度。哪句準確？

options.en: She paid a premium for the handwritten name, without evidence yet of a difference in durability.
options.zh: 她為手寫名字付額外費用，目前未有耐用度差異證據。

options.en: A durability test has already shown that the handwritten version lasts longer.
options.zh: 耐用測試已顯示手寫版本較耐用。

options.en: She selected the ordinary printed option at the base price.
options.zh: 她以基本價選一般印字方案。

scene.explanationZh: 已知多付手寫，不知耐用比較，並非選基本印字。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 pay a premium 推出？

options.en: The amount is above an ordinary or base price.
options.zh: 金額高於通常或基本價。

options.en: The extra cost is definitely worthwhile for every buyer.
options.zh: 額外費用對每位買家都必定值得。

options.en: The context may explain what attracts the additional charge.
options.zh: 情境可能解釋甚麼帶來額外收費。

contrast.explanationZh: 價格差本身不作所有人的價值判斷。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想因刊物付貴了就把紙寫成較高級，但收據只列加急送貨。哪句最好？

options.en: It paid a premium for speed; we should keep the paper quality unchanged in the summary.
options.zh: 它為速度付額外費用；摘要應保留紙質沒變。

options.en: The paper was upgraded as part of the extra charge.
options.zh: 額外收費包括提升紙質。

options.en: The journal paid the base price for the slower delivery.
options.zh: 刊物付基本價選較慢運送。

dialogue.explanationZh: 收據只列加急，紙質沒變；不是升紙質，也不是付基本價選慢送。

speaking.en: We paid a premium for the earlier slot, so the account should explain the timing rather than imply a better product.
speaking.zh: 我們為較早時段付額外費用，所以敘述應解釋時點，而非暗示產品較好。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出較高價格對應的具體加項。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為虛構市集寫收費說明，手工包裝需額外收費，基本包裝也可保護物件。你想讓顧客明白選擇而不以「高級」暗示基本版無效，亦不把自選加項寫成必付。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: Customers can choose to pay a premium for handmade wrapping, while the basic packaging still protects the item. The additional charge is optional and covers the wrapping work.
examples.zh: 顧客可自選為手工包裝付額外費用，基本包裝仍能保護物件；加項是自選，費用用於包裝工夫。

examples.en: Paying a premium here means choosing the handmade presentation, not buying the only protective option. We should state the basic and extra services separately.
examples.zh: 這裏付額外費用是選手工呈現，不是買唯一能保護物件的選項；我們應分開列基本及附加服務。

glossary.en: state the basic and extra services separately
glossary.zh: 分開列明基本及附加服務

writing.selfCheckZh: 清楚列基本及自選手工加項，避免讓讀者以為必付額外費用才有保護。

takeaways.en: The character paid a premium for a name on the box, though the contents were the same.
takeaways.zh: 角色為盒上名字付額外費用，內容卻相同。

takeaways.en: The organiser was willing to pay a premium for a suitable date but had not yet confirmed the booking.
takeaways.zh: 主辦者願為合適日期付額外費用，但尚未確認預約。

lessons.titleZh: 接受並認同某個構想或說法

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Shoppers may be buying into the promise of constant upgrades.
sources.locatorNote: Actual PDF page101, table1, row9; unreported locators remain null.

brief.meaningEn: Accept or support an idea, belief or claim.
brief.meaningZh: 接受或支持一個構想、信念或說法。
brief.grammar: buy into + idea/claim/plan; bought/buying; distinguish belief/support from a literal purchase of shares in a business.
brief.register: Common figurative sense, sometimes disapproving, but the accepted idea is not necessarily false. Primary Cambridge buy-into believing sense.
brief.boundaryZh: 需有接受或支持的對象；聽過不等於認同，認同也不證實說法為真。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可在有證據下支持構想，也可修正過早相信；不用一律譯成受騙。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述對構想的態度及依據，保留檢驗。

listening.en: We bought into the idea that more group messages would make everyone better informed, but the first trial showed important updates getting lost among repeated reminders.
listening.zh: 我們接受了群組訊息更多會讓人人更掌握資料的想法，但首輪試行顯示，重要更新被重複提醒淹沒。
listening.promptZh: 小組最初接受甚麼，試行又顯示甚麼？

options.en: It supported the more-messages idea, then found a practical problem with locating updates.
options.zh: 它支持更多訊息的想法，之後發現找更新的實際問題。

options.en: It rejected the idea before trying the message system.
options.zh: 它試訊息系統前已拒絕構想。

options.en: It purchased shares in a messaging company.
options.zh: 它買入訊息公司的股份。

options.en: The first trial confirmed that every update was easier to find.
options.zh: 首輪確認每項更新都較易找到。

listening.explanationZh: 接受信念不等於買股；試行提供與原先預期不符的資料。

reply.promptEn: Why did the group initially increase the number of messages?
reply.promptZh: 小組最初為甚麼增加訊息數？

options.en: It believed more messages would leave members better informed.
options.zh: 它相信更多訊息會讓成員更掌握資料。

options.en: It bought into the idea that more messages would improve communication.
options.zh: 它接受更多訊息會改善溝通的想法。

options.en: The group supported a proposed link between message volume and awareness.
options.zh: 小組支持訊息量與掌握資料程度有關的提法。

options.en: It accepted the claim before seeing what happened in the trial.
options.zh: 它在看試行結果前已接受主張。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都有最初接受說法的依據，不把後來問題改寫成最初已拒絕。

scene.promptZh: 同伴聽過「長評語總比短評語有用」，卻說需先試讀者能否用它修稿，尚未表示同意。哪句準確？

options.en: She has not yet bought into the claim; she wants to test how useful the comments are.
options.zh: 她尚未接受主張，想先測評語有多有用。

options.en: She accepted the claim without asking for a trial.
options.zh: 她接受主張，沒要求測試。

options.en: She has already compared the two versions and chosen the longer comments.
options.zh: 她已比較兩版本，選了較長評語。

scene.explanationZh: 她尚未接受，想先檢視用途；不是沒問就信，也不是比較已完成。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 buy into an idea 推出？

options.en: Someone accepts or supports the idea.
options.zh: 有人接受或支持構想。

options.en: The idea has thereby been proved correct.
options.zh: 構想因此已被證明正確。

options.en: The context can show why the person came to support it.
options.zh: 情境可顯示那人為何支持。

contrast.explanationZh: 態度不等於構想已證實。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想把你們改訊息流程寫成從沒相信過原主張，但你們確曾先接受才試。哪句最好？

options.en: We bought into the idea at first, then changed our view after the trial; both stages belong in the account.
options.zh: 我們最初接受構想，試行後才改看法；敘述應保留兩階段。

options.en: We rejected the idea before any trial began.
options.zh: 任何試行開始前，我們已拒絕構想。

options.en: We can ignore the trial results because the group once supported the claim.
options.zh: 小組曾支持主張，所以可忽略試行結果。

dialogue.explanationZh: 保留信念改變的時間線，過往支持不排除新資料。

speaking.en: I bought into the idea after seeing a useful trial, but I still want to review whether it works in the next setting.
speaking.zh: 我見有用試行後接受構想，但仍想檢視它在下一情境是否有效。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再連結接受構想的依據及保留檢驗。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：居民小聚會讓長者及年輕人各帶一件家中物講故事，幾位平常安靜成員也自願提建議。你原怕共同選展題會混亂，現在願支持讓居民參與提題，但想先說明討論及選擇規則，不假定所有居民已同意。用一至兩句英文向組員表達。

examples.en: I am buying into the idea of residents helping to choose the exhibition theme after hearing new voices at the gathering. Before the next meeting, we should explain how suggestions will be discussed and selected.
examples.zh: 聚會聽到新聲音後，我開始支持居民幫選展題；下次會前，應說明建議怎討論及選擇。

examples.en: Seeing quieter members offer stories helped me buy into shared theme-setting. I support inviting residents into that choice, but we still need clear rules and cannot assume everyone has agreed.
examples.zh: 見較安靜成員講故事，幫我接受共同訂題；我支持邀居民參與選擇，但仍需清楚規則，也不能假定人人已同意。

writing.selfCheckZh: 以安靜成員也願參與的觀察支持居民提題，交代仍需討論規則及徵求意願，不把一次回應當全民已同意。

takeaways.en: The committee bought into the proposal after the small trial showed how residents could take part.
takeaways.zh: 小試行展示居民可怎參與後，委員會接受提案。

takeaways.en: She was buying into the promise of an easier routine before checking which tasks the device could actually handle.
takeaways.zh: 查裝置實際可處理哪些任務前，她正接受日常會更輕鬆的承諾。
